passing: Provider selection round trip preserves synthetic credentials and Claude passthrough strips foreign resume only.
regressions: Sequential polling delivers stop only after the CLI closes.
Voice does not download/transcribe or invoke the agent.
Typing, original rotating status and final-message/footer delivery are absent; lone checkmark remains.
Stale native auth file is accepted without checking login and switches provider.
Non-owner overlay callback switches provider before core guard.
Codex error drops session; stream cut replays the operation in another thread.
limits: No real Telegram/Deepgram/Claude/Codex authentication, server or Linux process-tree test.
This initial suite is not the complete acceptance matrix: long responses, all timeout cases, reset/switch races and actual successful Codex model execution remain future coverage.
